meta.title: Add benchmark support to Haskell transpiler
meta.body_summary: Add benchmark mode to the Haskell transpiler, including new golden test input and updated ROSETTA.md documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit feature addition of benchmark mode with no review; merged instantly by the author.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 892 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but the majority (570 lines) is in ROSETTA.md documentation updates; the functional code changes are modest (~100 lines across transpiler and tests). This fits a feature addition that adds benchmark infrastructure, and the fast merge without review is consistent with a trusted maintainer self-merging an incremental improvement.

review_details.performance_claim: Adds infrastructure for benchmarking transpiler performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding benchmark support to an existing Haskell transpiler with test harness; Codex successfully extended the codebase with a benchmark mode and related golden file updates, demonstrating capability within the transpiler domain when the change pattern is well-established.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark results or performance data in PR; only test commands to run the benchmark mode.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression handling as no perf regression was reported.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchmark mode to the Haskell transpiler (transpiler.go) controlled by MOCHI_BENCHMARK env var; updated rosetta_test.go to support benchmark flag; added new benchmark golden input file (100-doors-2.bench) and updated existing test inputs (.hs files); updated ROSETTA.md and golden test descriptors.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining changes are test input modifications and extensive documentation update in ROSETTA.md.
change_trajectory: Added benchmark support in transpiler.go and rosetta_test.go; created new benchmark input file; updated existing test inputs and golden test files; updated ROSETTA.md with benchmark results.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened and immediately merged by author without external review.
